module_name_en: Core Words III and Graded Reading
covers: levels 1-30 (checkpoints 1-6). Checkpoints 7-11 and the mock cover levels 31-55.
format_note_en: Part F's mix fits here in a third way again. This module teaches words and reading, so its checkpoints use meaning_match and near_synonym_choice from the vocabulary items and comprehension and inference from the reading items — plus one type the module earned: gender_recall. Forty-two of the 105 vocabulary items carry gender_flag because their gender cannot be guessed from their shape, and a checkpoint that never tested those would ignore the single most error-prone thing in the module.

questions.prompt_en: Which postposition goes with भरोसा?
questions.explanation_en: भरोसा rests on somebody — उस पर भरोसा है.

questions.prompt_en: Which of these is masculine?
questions.explanation_en: फ़ैसला ends in -आ and is masculine. The other three are feminine, and the first two are consonant-final, which tells you nothing.

questions.question_en: Which word means an attempt, in the formal register?
questions.explanation_en: प्रयास — and note it is masculine where कोशिश is feminine.

questions.prompt_en: What does the suffix -आई build?
questions.explanation_en: सच्चाई, लड़ाई, पढ़ाई, कमाई — all feminine, without exception.

questions.question_en: Which word means freedom in the political sense as well as personal liberty?
questions.explanation_en: आज़ादी covers both. छुट्टी is time off and फ़ुर्सत is unhurriedness.

questions.prompt_en: हालात is which of these?
questions.explanation_en: हालात is the plural of हाल and takes plural agreement — हालात ठीक नहीं हैं.

questions.prompt_en: Which adjective never changes for gender?
questions.explanation_en: -ी adjectives like ज़िद्दी and मेहनती are invariable. -ईला adjectives like शर्मीला inflect.

questions.question_en: Which word means an opinion or notion, as in मेरे ___ से?
questions.explanation_en: मेरे ख़याल से — one of the three fixed phrases for "in my view", each with its own postposition.

questions.prompt_en: मेरी राय ___ — which postposition?
questions.explanation_en: मेरी राय में, but मेरे ख़याल से and मेरे हिसाब से. There is no pattern; they are fixed phrases.

questions.prompt_en: Which pair has two different genders?
questions.explanation_en: प्रयास is masculine and कोशिश is feminine, though they mean the same thing. Changing register can change the agreement.

questions.prompt_en: A sign reads प्रवेश निषेध. What does it mean?
questions.explanation_en: प्रवेश is entry and निषेध is prohibition — the most official of the three ways a sign forbids something.

questions.question_en: Which is the everyday word a person would use for प्रवेश?
questions.explanation_en: Signs and speech split here: प्रवेश on the board, अंदर आना out loud.

questions.prompt_en: निःशुल्क means what?
questions.explanation_en: निः- is the Sanskrit negating prefix and शुल्क is a fee.

questions.context_en: A sign reads: धूम्रपान पूर्णतः निषेध। उल्लंघन पर जुर्माना।
questions.question_en: What does the second line add?
options: That there is a penalty for breaking the rule
questions.explanation_en: उल्लंघन is a violation and जुर्माना a fine. The first line states the rule and the second gives it teeth.

questions.prompt_en: What does the suffix -आलय mean?
questions.explanation_en: शौचालय, विद्यालय, पुस्तकालय, चिकित्सालय, न्यायालय — half the public buildings from one suffix.

questions.question_en: Which word describes somebody who is clever in a way that may not be a compliment?
questions.explanation_en: चालाक swings between clever and sly depending on tone. होशियार is the safe positive.

questions.prompt_en: लापरवाह is built how?
options: It is not built from parts
ला- plus परवाह, a Persian negating prefix
questions.explanation_en: ला- is Persian and परवाह is care, so it means careless. अ- and निः- are the Sanskrit-side equivalents.

questions.question_en: Which word means arrogant?
questions.explanation_en: घमंडी from घमंड, pride. ज़िद्दी is stubborn, which is a different failing.

questions.context_en: A sign reads: पूछताछ केंद्र मुख्य द्वार के पास है।
questions.question_en: What is being pointed to?
questions.explanation_en: पूछताछ is an echo compound from पूछना — asking and asking.

questions.prompt_en: Which of these is feminine?
questions.explanation_en: पूछताछ is feminine. The other three are masculine and none of them shows it in its shape.

questions.question_en: Which word means reasoning, and does not take करना?
questions.explanation_en: तर्क is reasoning as such. बहस takes करना and दलील takes देना.

questions.prompt_en: Which verb goes with दलील?
questions.explanation_en: दलील देना — a point is advanced, not done.

questions.prompt_en: Which is masculine?
questions.explanation_en: नज़रिया ends in -आ and is masculine. The other three are feminine.

questions.question_en: Which word means the visible event rather than the underlying stance?
questions.explanation_en: विरोध is the opposition itself; प्रदर्शन is the march or the demonstration.

questions.prompt_en: असहमत is built how?
options: It is not built from parts
questions.explanation_en: अ- is the Sanskrit negating prefix, and it is the most productive of the module's seven.

questions.context_en: A sign reads: चेतावनी। यहाँ पानी बहुत गहरा है। बच्चों को अकेला न छोड़ें।
questions.question_en: What are you told about children?
options: They must stay on the path
They must not be left alone
They must be supervised by a lifeguard
questions.explanation_en: न छोड़ें — and न rather than मत, because this is written.

questions.prompt_en: Which negative belongs on a written notice?
questions.explanation_en: नहीं negates statements, मत negates spoken instructions, and न negates written ones.

questions.context_en: A notice reads: लिफ़्ट मरम्मत के कारण बंद है। कृपया सीढ़ियों का प्रयोग करें। असुविधा के लिए खेद।
questions.question_en: What does the notice offer somebody carrying heavy luggage?
questions.explanation_en: The apology exists precisely because the line before it offers nothing else.

questions.prompt_en: असुविधा is built from which word you already know?
questions.explanation_en: अ- plus सुविधा, the facility from the level 8 sign. Inconvenience is un-facility.

questions.question_en: Which word for waiting would a sign print?
questions.explanation_en: प्रतीक्षा कक्ष on the board, इंतज़ार in speech — and the two have different genders.

questions.prompt_en: निष्कर्ष goes with which verb?
questions.explanation_en: निष्कर्ष is literally a drawing-out — निः plus कर्ष — which is why English also draws a conclusion.

questions.question_en: Which word means the point at issue, as opposed to a question or a matter?
questions.explanation_en: मुद्दा is what is contentious. मामला is the affair and सवाल is a question — and मुद्दा is raised, not asked.

questions.prompt_en: Which formal word has no everyday single-word equivalent?
questions.explanation_en: Speech rewrites the sentence — ये मिल जाएगा — rather than swapping उपलब्ध for another adjective.

questions.context_en: An email opens: विषय: छुट्टी के लिए आवेदन. महोदय, निवेदन है कि मुझे चार दिन की छुट्टी चाहिए।
questions.question_en: What is being asked for?
questions.explanation_en: निवेदन है कि opens a request made upwards, to somebody in a position to grant it.

questions.prompt_en: दिनांक and तारीख़ mean the same thing. What is unusual about them?
questions.explanation_en: दिनांक is masculine and तारीख़ feminine — आज का दिनांक but आज की तारीख़.

questions.prompt_en: Which three words head an official Hindi letter?
questions.explanation_en: Learn the three together and you can orient yourself in any official document in seconds.

questions.prompt_en: संबंधित विभाग से संपर्क करें means what?
questions.explanation_en: And notably it does not say which department. Part of the phrase's function is to avoid naming anybody.

questions.prompt_en: पूर्व does NOT mean which of these?
questions.explanation_en: Three meanings in one word, separated only by context — पूर्व प्रधानमंत्री is a former prime minister, not an eastern one.

questions.context_en: A sign reads: टिकट खिड़की। ट्रेन के प्रस्थान से आधा घंटा पूर्व बंद। अग्रिम बुकिंग ऑनलाइन उपलब्ध है।
questions.question_en: Your train leaves at 6:15 and you arrive at 5:50. What follows?
options: You can buy a ticket on board
You have twenty-five minutes to buy a ticket
The window shut at 5:45, so you would have needed to book online
questions.explanation_en: The closing rule gives 5:45, and the only remaining route is the line after it.

questions.prompt_en: विषय does NOT mean which of these?
questions.explanation_en: English "subject" also means a citizen. Hindi's विषय never does.

questions.prompt_en: Which is masculine?
questions.explanation_en: हस्ताक्षर is masculine — हस्त, hand, plus अक्षर, a letter. The other three are feminine.

questions.question_en: Which is the everyday word for हस्ताक्षर?
questions.explanation_en: दस्तख़त is what the bank clerk will say. हस्तलेख is handwriting.

questions.context_en: A message reads: अरे यार सॉरी, मीटिंग में था। फ़ोन साइलेंट पर था। सब ठीक है ना?
questions.question_en: What tells you these two are close?
options: यार, the dropped subjects, and the ना tag
questions.explanation_en: English words alone prove nothing — plenty of formal writing has them. यार and the ना are the signal.

questions.prompt_en: In a request, what is एक छोटी सी गुज़ारिश थी doing with the past tense?
questions.explanation_en: Putting the asking one step back makes it easier to refuse — the same instinct as "I was wondering whether".

questions.question_en: Which request word is warm and personal rather than formal or neutral?
questions.explanation_en: निवेदन goes upwards, अनुरोध is level, गुज़ारिश is warm. आदेश goes the other way entirely.

questions.context_en: A message reads: कल आपके यहाँ नहीं आ सका, इसके लिए क्षमा चाहता हूँ। ... आपने इतनी तैयारी की थी, बहुत बुरा लगा। ... माफ़ कीजिएगा।
questions.question_en: What does आपने इतनी तैयारी की थी add?
options: An acknowledgement of the trouble she went to, not only his absence
A request that she prepare again
A suggestion the event did not matter
An explanation of why he could not come
questions.explanation_en: The apology is doubled — sorry I was absent, and sorry you went to trouble.

questions.prompt_en: A message reads छुट्टी की स्वीकृति मिल गई है ... छुट्टी मंज़ूर है। What do the two lines show?
options: स्वीकृति and मंज़ूरी are the same thing on two sides of the vocabulary
questions.explanation_en: Sanskrit-side and Urdu-side, one line apart, and both feminine. The writer is not being inconsistent.

questions.question_en: Which word can be a noun as well as an adjective?
questions.explanation_en: एक मुश्किल आ गई works; एक कठिन आ गई does not. The Sanskrit-side noun is कठिनाई.

questions.prompt_en: प्रारंभ is a noun. What is शुरू?
options: Not a noun — it behaves like an invariable adjective
questions.explanation_en: काम शुरू हुआ, but कार्यक्रम का प्रारंभ. The noun on that side is शुरुआत, and it is feminine.

questions.question_en: Which pair is genuinely interchangeable, differing only in setting?
questions.explanation_en: समाप्त and ख़त्म are both invariable and both take होना and करना. The first and third are asymmetric.

checkpoints.title_en: The register pairs, and formal email

questions.prompt_en: उत्तर प्रदेश means what?
questions.explanation_en: उत्तर is north here. Nothing but context separates it from उत्तर meaning an answer.

questions.question_en: Which word for time would a song reach for?
questions.explanation_en: वक़्त carries more feeling. अवधि is a measured period and would be absurd in a song.

questions.prompt_en: स्थान and जगह mean the same thing. Which is feminine?
questions.explanation_en: जगह is feminine and स्थान masculine — the third mismatched pair in the module.

questions.prompt_en: आवश्यकता and ज़रूरत — what is true of their genders?
questions.explanation_en: They match. Roughly half the module's pairs mismatch and half do not, so each has to be known.

questions.prompt_en: Why is there no word कामक्रम?
options: Free words swap between registers; compounds do not
काम is not a real word
questions.explanation_en: The single most reliable difference between the two sides — the Sanskrit side takes the compounds.

questions.prompt_en: Which prefix negates मुमकिन?
questions.explanation_en: नामुमकिन. संभव takes अ- instead, giving असंभव — each word keeps the prefix from its own side.

questions.question_en: Which word appears in the compound for life insurance?
questions.explanation_en: जीवन बीमा. ज़िंदगी owns the feeling and जीवन owns the compounds.

questions.prompt_en: ख़बर and समाचार mean roughly the same. Which is masculine?
questions.explanation_en: समाचार is masculine, ख़बर feminine — and समाचार is news as a body where ख़बर is one item of it.

questions.prompt_en: Which government department name is possible?
questions.explanation_en: तालीम is entirely current as a free word and will never name a ministry.

questions.context_en: An email reads: विषय: मासिक रिपोर्ट। महोदय, इस महीने की रिपोर्ट अनुलग्नक में भेज रहा हूँ। कुछ आँकड़े अभी अधूरे हैं।
questions.question_en: Why send a report he says is incomplete?
options: So that it can be reviewed while the last figures are finished
questions.explanation_en: He flags what is missing and asks for it to be looked over anyway. The reason sits in the gap between the two lines.
